symbolizer.prompt: Render as a low-altitude black-and-white aerial survey photograph of the Po delta, in the style of the 1976-78 Emilia-Romagna flight: fine film grain, soft contrast, no colour cast. Cultivated fields, drainage ditches and field boundaries fill the neutral ground between the mapped units.

control._comment: Muted, terrain-plausible colours on purpose — see the README note on choosing control colours. Saturated colours read to the model as an annotation overlay it should preserve, and survive into the output as flat neon; colours already near the target material get repainted, and degrade gracefully when they aren't.

Dossi.describe: a raised sandy dune ridge — pale dry soil, sparse scrub, slightly higher than the surrounding fields

Dossi (Valle Pega).describe: a low sandy rise under cultivation

Paleoalvei.describe: a silted-up former river channel — dark damp clay, sinuous, sharply darker than the fields around it

Cordoni.describe: a beach ridge of pale dry sand running parallel to the old shoreline

Linea di costa.describe: shallow brackish lagoon water, flat and featureless

Ustrina (aree).describe: a burnt cremation area — scorched dark ground, bare of vegetation

Palificazioni (legno).describe: a waterlogged timber piling structure at the water's edge

Abitato.describe: a low earthen settlement mound with beaten ground

Passerelle.describe: a narrow raised timber walkway over wet ground
